title: telnet: Simplify handling of Telnet option lookup.
description:
Handling telnet options by their "tn_opt" structure pointer allows for
elimination of some duplicated logic and will make it easier to add support for
Telnet options which are not consecutively numbered.  Unknown options are
handled through a special tn_opt just for that purpose.  Behavior should be
unchanged.

While we're here, constify the option table.

notes.body:
The motivation here is to facilitate adding dissection for the [VMware virtual serial port proxy telnet extensions](https://vdc-repo.vmware.com/vmwb-repository/dcr-public/ee7ce7d0-089b-43fa-a1c7-794d513339ef/1ca15d04-987f-492d-a06c-060826ae2964/using-a-proxy-with-virtual-serial-ports-70.pdf).  The `VMWARE-TELNET-EXT` option value is 232, so extending the array would not be reasonable, and keeping special-case logic in sync in two separate places is not optimal.

Fuzz-tested 100,000 passes on an M1 Mac mini.  Did encounter some failures, always in a background thread (`Thread 1 Crashed::  Dispatch queue: com.apple.libdispatch-manager`), always in `mvm_madvise_free` -> `_platform_memset`.  Saw the same failures occurring even without my changes, though.
